answer_1.quote: We demonstrate that BaryScore provides better results than a large variety of state-of-art untrained metrics on four text generation tasks: namely NMT, summarization, image captioning, data2text suggesting that Wasserstein barycenters offer a promising direction moving forward.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation (AE) of Natural Language Generation (NLG) is a key problem towards better systems . It allows to assess the quality of generated text without relying on human evaluation campaigns that are expensive and time consuming .
